name: Mariposa County Behavioral Health
description: Providing treatment, education, prevention and information to assist those who may be uninsured or under insured with accessing and receiving care to recover and become well.

name: Community Health Centers of America
description: Offers dependable healthcare services to low-income families, accepting all forms of insurance and providing sliding-scale discounts for the uninsured. MACT Health Board

name: Connections Emergency Shelter
description: Our clinics are specialized and allow patients to receive affordable care for most Medical, Dental, Behavioral Health, Optometry, and Chiropractic needs. Medical services are available to all Native Americans, their family members, and the public. Mariposa Heritage House

name: Mountain Crisis Services
description: Offers counseling support groups, emergency shelter, legal advocacy and transitional housing.

name: Welfare to Work
description: Opportunities for training, counseling, education, and work experience to CalWORKs recipients. All participants are given an assessment to determine specific needs so that a customized case plan can be developed.
